newsitem.title: USA: Thomson Financial plans advertising campaign.
newsitem.headline: Thomson Financial plans advertising campaign.

text.p: Thomson Financial Services, a subsidiary of Toronto-based Thomson Corp, said Thursday it was launching an advertising campaign to make its name and products better known to the financial markets.

Mason Slaine, president and chief executive officer of TFS, said the company was making the move "because Thomson has so many products -- a variety of business and financial publications that our clients are already using -- but they don't know that they're Thomson products."

Slaine is hoping that brand recognition will lead to to an increase in the number of products sold to its customers, who are predominantly institutional investors, brokers, traders and mutual fund companies.

The first televison commercial in the campaign will appear during business programs aired on the CNBC and CNN cable channels, according to Kevin Lorenc, Thomson's spokesman. The print component will appear business publications.
Lorenc said New York-based Citigate Inc was handling the account.
